loadContract.pattern: Local LazyFeatureBoundary starts import() from an effect only while its surface is active. DisclosureSection keeps the boundary mounted after the first open while its owner tool remains mounted.
loadContract.importTimeDomainWork: None found in selected feature module entry points; operations remain explicit callbacks.
loadContract.importFailure: Feature-local alert with a Reload application action. Reload resets a browser-cached failed module URL before it is attempted again. Event-triggered report imports show an inline alert with the same reload action.
loadContract.hashedAssets: Vite content-hashed chunks; no behavior depends on generated hash strings.
